To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The design rules for the Tet-Off system can be applied to the Tet-On system with some modifications; (2) The design rules of the Tet-On system can be applied with minor modifications to the Tet-Off systems; (3) The design rules can be applied to other regulatory systems; and (4) The design rules are applicable for both the transient and the steady-state behavior.
we have designed four novel regulatory gene expression systems that can achieve tighter control over gene expression.

1) the design of a gene expression regulatory network requires a systematic investigation of its dynamic behavior and 2) computer simulations can accurately predict the dynamic behavior of these networks, and thus can be used to guide the rational design of novel networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the rational synthesis of gene regulatory networks.
computer aided engineering and design of synthetic gene regulatory networks.
the design of synthetic gene regulatory networks and the development of computer aided design principles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
computer simulations are essential to understand and engineer gene regulatory networks.
computer aided design of regulatory networks can be used to rationally engineer novel regulatory systems with desired properties.
the design of gene regulatory networks is possible with the use of computer simulations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to propose and test design principles for synthetic gene networks and develop a set of clear guidelines for the design of tetracycline inducible networks.
the dynamic properties of a gene regulatory network can be accurately captured and the network can be engineered with computer aided design.
we are able to propose new networks with desired dynamic behavior, such as tight regulation, fast and accurate response, and high inducer sensitivity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use computer simulations to design novel gene regulatory networks.
we can use computer aided design to improve the synthesis and design of novel regulatory systems.
the dynamic behavior of a network can be used to design novel regulatory systems.
